description: Live availability of APL cars near a location, from fleet GPS. The target is an airport or cruise-port code (LHR, LGW, STN, LTN, LCY, EDI, SOU, BHX, MAN), a UK postcode, or lat+lng. Returns the free cars (online, not on a job) grouped by car class with a drive ETA rounded to 5 minutes; on hosts with UI the result renders as the 'Cars near you' card. With `destination` the result also carries the final fixed fare of every car class for that trip (same pricing engine as the quote; pickup = now plus the nearest car's ETA unless transfer_date / transfer_time are given, so a pickup under 3 hours away already includes the 20% last-minute surcharge) and the card shows a Book button per car. min_pax limits the result to vehicles of at least that size. Customer and partner callers receive an availability view only: car class (Saloon / People Carrier / 8 Seater, executive flag), seats and ETA for up to 5 cars, never a driver name, vehicle, plate, position, distance or fleet size (driver details are shared after a booking is confirmed). Staff callers see full detail and can include busy drivers.

destination.description: Optional drop-off (full postcode, address, London landmark, station or uniquely named hotel; airports are fine). When given, the result also carries the fixed fares from the target to this destination for every car class, and the card shows Book buttons.

include_on_job.description: Also include drivers currently on a job (default false = available only).

min_pax.description: Only vehicles seating at least this many passengers.

passengers.description: With destination: passenger count if the customer said it (marks the recommended car).

postcode.description: UK postcode, e.g. "SW1A 1AA", or just the district, e.g. "SL4".

transfer_date.description: With destination: travel date YYYY-MM-DD for a LATER trip. Default = today (Europe/London).

transfer_time.description: With destination: pickup time HH:MM (Europe/London) for a later trip. Default = now plus the nearest car's ETA, rounded up to 5 minutes — an ASAP pickup, whose under-3-hours surcharge is already in the fare.
